# Keeper's Compendium Excerpt

Synthetic rules fixture for regression testing. No published rulebook text is reproduced here.

## Skill Checks

When the keeper calls for a roll, the acting investigator compares the roll to the relevant percentile skill.

## Bonus And Penalty Dice

Bonus dice represent favorable circumstances. Penalty dice represent adverse conditions.

## Sanity Pressure

Repeated unnatural exposure should escalate the emotional cost of investigation and change how the keeper frames consequences.
